known_bugs.summary: The target change treats the negative maxIdle sentinel as an ordinary numeric bound, so addObject() becomes a no-op when idle capacity is unlimited.

preservation.summary: The complete public test suite available at the target head remains green.

curation_notes: The issue-linked fix commit also added synchronization for a separate concurrency concern.
Maintainers immediately removed that synchronization because factory callbacks must not execute while the pool lock is held.
The reference patch is not a gold implementation; only the K-001 behavior and preservation requirements are authoritative.
